item.title: RUMOR: Marvel Studios Will Release THREE Different AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Teaser Trailers (But There's A Catch)
item.description: We have an update about the Avengers: Doomsday trailer...or should that be trailers? Disney reportedly has some unique plans for the long-awaited sneak peek, but you'll need to see Avatar: Fire and Ash!

item.title: RUMOR: [SPOILER] Will Be Part Of Next Year's SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Reshoots
item.description: Spider-Man: Brand New Day is close to wrapping, but at least one key cast member is rumoured for next year's planned reshoots...right around the time cameras will be rolling on Avengers: Doomsday again.

item.title: ANACONDA: New Teaser And Character Posters For Sony's Meta Horror Comedy Reboot Slither Online
item.description: Sony Pictures has released a new teaser and a series of character posters for the upcoming reboot of Anaconda, which stars Paul Rudd, Jack Black, and Daniela Melchior...

item.title: Jason Statham Is Unleashed As SHELTER Trailer Sees An Elite Assassin Confront His Deadly Past
item.description: Jason Statham steps back into familiar action territory as Mason, a retired assassin who’s reluctantly dragged back into action to safeguard a young girl, in the upcoming action thriller Shelter.

item.title: Gal Gadot Reveals Wonder Woman Screen Test For BATMAN V SUPERMAN To Celebrate 12th Anniversary Of Her Casting
item.description: It’s been 12 years since Gal Gadot was cast as Wonder Woman. To celebrate, the actress took to social media to share her screen test for Batman v Superman, featuring Ben Affleck.

item.title: UPDATE: SUPERGIRL: Closer Look At CCXP Display, Movie Logo, And First Official Merchandise Revealed
item.description: We have some clearer shots of the Supergirl CCXP display here, along with a first look at some official tie-in merchandise for the next DCU movie...

item.title: STRANGER THINGS Star Calls Miles Morales’ Spider-Man A “Dream Role”
item.description: Caleb McLaughlin, who plays Lucas Sinclair in Stranger Things, revealed during an interview that Miles Morales’ Spider-Man is one of his dream roles.
